verdicts.originalText: Adeptal Assistance stack consumption (8 stacks consumed by team plunge attacks) is not modelled; the A4 plunge buff fires for the full 16s window regardless of how many plunges have occurred.
verdicts.proposedText: Not modeled: Adeptal Assistance's 8 stacks, one spent per team plunge. The plunge buff is shown for the full 16s window regardless of how many plunges have happened.
verdicts.rationale: Real gap (consumeStacks on a plunge/onHit trigger is unmodeled per CANNOT list; the plunge-enabling / field-redirect mechanic is out of scope by constitution), so keep the warning but compress: fix banned 'modelled' spelling, drop the 'A4' ability name per de-naming rule (the buff is referenced as 'the plunge buff'), and trim to the divergence. All content traces to the original caveat and the burst description ('Starts with 8 stacks of Adeptal Assistance'; each plunge 'consume[s] 1 stack').
